scripts.title: Echo hub 99 nights
scripts.features:
Take full control of the survival horror experience with a powerful all-in-one automation script designed to handle combat, farming, base building, exploration, and progression for you.

Whether you're defending your camp from The Deer, The Owl, Cultists, Wolves, Bears, and Rams, or exploring dangerous biomes like Volcano and Snow, this script gives you complete domination over the game.

Built with a clean GUI, smooth performance, and powerful automation, this script makes surviving all 99 nights easier than ever.

⚔️ Combat & Defense

Kill Aura

Automatically attacks and eliminates nearby enemies within a customizable radius.

Chop Aura

Instantly chops nearby trees for unlimited wood and fuel supply.

Auto Stun (Deer / Owl)

Automatically stuns dangerous entities using the correct mechanics.

God Mode

Become completely invincible against enemies, corruption, invasions, and environmental hazards.

Auto Tame Animals

Instantly tame wolves, mammoths, and other animals to defend your camp.

🌾 Smart Farming & Automation

Auto Farm Resources Automatically collects essential survival resources:

Wood

Fuel (Coal, Gasoline, Chairs)

Food

Medicine

Diamonds

Junk Items

Bring Items Teleports useful items directly to your camp.

Auto Plant Saplings Automatically replants trees to maintain a sustainable wood supply.

Auto Cook Food Automatically cooks food at the crock pot.

Auto Feed Maintains hunger and thirst automatically.

Auto Scrap Junk Automatically sells junk items for diamonds.

Auto Rescue Kids Instantly teleports to missing children and rescues them, reducing the total nights required.

🏕 Base & Progression

Auto Upgrade Campfire & Crafting Bench Instantly upgrade campfire levels and crafting tiers to unlock:

Compass

Sundial

Farm Plots

Lightning Rod

Auto Build Defenses Automatically places powerful camp defenses such as:

Log Walls

Bear Traps

Laser Fences

Barbed Wire

Lava Mines

Auto Nights / Skip Progression Advance the day-night cycle or instantly skip to Night 99.

Infinite Diamonds Generate diamonds for class rerolls and upgrades like the Scavenger Class.

🚀 Movement & Exploration

Fly Mode Freely fly around the map to explore quickly.

No Clip Walk through walls and obstacles.

Speed Hack Adjustable walk speed and jump power for faster travel.

Teleport Menu Instant teleport options including:

Campfire

Lost Kids

Trader

Stronghold

Safe Zones

Loot Locations

Random Chests

Map Scan Teleports

Instant Interact Removes delays for crafting, trading, and looting.

👁 Visuals & ESP

Full ESP System See everything through walls including:

Enemies

Players

Items

Lost Kids

Animals

Chests

Fullbright Removes darkness for perfect night visibility.

No Fog Eliminates fog and visual obstructions.

Disable Corruption Effects Removes corruption visual interference.

Map Scanner Reveals the entire map including biomes and loot locations.

🛠 Extra Features

Anti-AFK Prevents inactivity kicks during automation.

Server Stability Protection Helps maintain stability even in large servers.

Modern GUI Clean interface with:

Organized tabs

Toggle buttons

Adjustable sliders

Smooth performance

Hard Mode Bypass Automatically handles corruption rifts, meters, and debuffs.

⭐ Why Players Use This Script

✔ Fully automated survival

✔ Perfect for farming resources

✔ Easily defeat night invasions

✔ Reach Night 99 with minimal effort

✔ Clean & beginner-friendly interface
